source_findings: Compressed stored-state requests use retained-token extraction only inside the certificate-refusal fallback path in Service.solve.
A single replay is reused if later stages also refuse; source words must match every stored source digest and lie inside archived enclosures.

All completed request rows and both endpoints remain in the prepared reduction.
Existing manuscript source-access assertions are restricted to the verified V67/V89 trajectories; limitations already state that fallback requires source access.
